title: Early Dieting in Girls: a Longitudinal Cohort Study
brief_summary: This longitudinal observational cohort followed the growth and development of non-Hispanic white girls from age 5 to 15 years, with a focus on the development of the controls of food intake.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Living with both biological parents

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe food allergies
* Chronic medical conditions affecting food intake
study_population: Families in central Pennsylvania with a 5-6 year old daughter.
